metadata.chunk_title: 3. Submit Application to USCIS for Processing

facts.value: Do not submit your application to USCIS more than 90 days before your Post OPT end date.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: USCIS must receive your application within 60 days of the date your I-20 was issued AND before your Post OPT end date.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: The ISSC recommends applying online at least the day before these deadlines to ensure your application is received by USCIS in time.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: The USCIS application portal does not have the same time zone as Arizona; therefore, depending on when you submit your application, it may be receipted by USCIS the next day.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: Applications received by USCIS more than 60 days after your I-20 was issued and/or after your Post OPT end date will be denied by USCIS.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: This time frame is counted by the day, not by the month.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: If you will not be able to submit your application to USCIS within 60 days of receiving your I-20, you must request a new I-20 from the ISSC by emailing [issc@asu.edu].

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: Print, sign and date your STEM OPT I-20 in blue ink.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: Do not forget to upload your STEM OPT I-20 or it may result in a delay or denial.

metadata.chunk_title: Tips for Avoiding Application Rejections, Denials, Delays, and Receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from USCIS:

facts.value: If you receive a Rejection, Denial, or a Request for Evidence (RFE) Notice from USCIS, complete the USCIS Notice Upload eForm for further advisement.

metadata.chunk_title: Biometrics Appointments for OPT Applicants

facts.value: USCIS may require you to attend an in-person appointment at a local Application Support Center (ASC) after you submit your application.

metadata.chunk_title: Biometrics Appointments for OPT Applicants

facts.value: It is very important that you attend as scheduled, as missing your appointment could lead to the denial of your application.

metadata.chunk_title: Biometrics Appointments for OPT Applicants

facts.value: The ASC Appointment Notice for biometrics (Form I-797C) will include the date, time, and location of your appointment, as well as details about what you may need to prepare.
